name: Multiple Congenital Anomalies/Dysmorphic Syndrome

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical Diagnostic Criteria for Multiple Congenital Anomalies/Dysmorphic Syndrome

criteria.description: Presence of two or more major congenital anomalies affecting different organ systems
Characteristic craniofacial dysmorphic features such as hypertelorism, micrognathia, and low-set ears
Global developmental delay or intellectual disability documented by standardized testing

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: At least two major congenital anomalies involving different organ systems plus characteristic dysmorphic facial features
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may support diagnosis but is not always definitive due to heterogeneity.

pathognomonic.notes: Widely spaced eyes characteristic of the syndrome
Small lower jaw contributing to feeding difficulties
Abnormally positioned ears often noted at birth

common.notes: Including ventricular septal defects and atrial septal defects
Delayed milestones in motor and cognitive domains
searchTerms: global delay in growth and skills

common.notes: Reduced muscle tone contributing to motor delay

occasional.notes: Midline or lateral clefts affecting feeding and speech
Such as clinodactyly or limb length discrepancies

rare.notes: Epileptic seizures reported in a minority of cases
Recurrent infections due to immune system abnormalities
Including hypothyroidism or growth hormone deficiency

laboratory: Chromosomal microarray may reveal copy number variations
Metabolic screening to exclude inborn errors of metabolism
imaging: Echocardiography to identify structural heart defects
Brain MRI for structural brain abnormalities
genetic: Heterogeneous genetic mutations identified in some cases
No single causative gene; diagnosis often clinical
other: Detailed dysmorphology assessment by clinical geneticist

distinguishingFeatures: Specific chromosomal abnormalities detected by karyotype
Distinctive facial features unique to each syndrome
Characteristic facial features and neurobehavioral deficits

redFlags: Multiple major congenital anomalies involving different organ systems
references: Orphanet: Multiple Congenital Anomalies/Dysmorphic Syndrome, ORPHA:68341
UpToDate: Approach to the child with multiple congenital anomalies
